title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 6: the four chariots between the mountains of bronze, and the crowns set on the head of Joshua.

questions.text: What came out from between the two mountains?
questions.explanation: The speaker lifted up his eyes and saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains.

answers.text: Four horns
Four chariots
Two olive trees
Two women with wings

questions.text: What were the two mountains made of?
questions.explanation: The text says the mountains were mountains of bronze.

answers.text: Stone
Silver
Iron
Bronze

questions.text: Which horses were in the fourth chariot?
questions.explanation: In the first chariot were red horses, in the second black horses, in the third white horses, and in the fourth dappled horses, all of them powerful.

answers.text: Red horses
Black horses
Dappled horses
White horses

questions.text: What did the angel say the four chariots are?
questions.explanation: The angel answered that these are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

answers.text: The four winds of the sky
The four horns of the nations
The four craftsmen
The four seasons of the year

questions.text: Toward which country did the chariot with the black horses go out?
questions.explanation: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country, and the dappled went out toward the south country.

answers.text: The south country
The north country
The east country
The west country

questions.text: What was said to the strong, who went out and sought to walk through the earth?
questions.explanation: He said, "Go around and through the earth!" So they walked back and forth through the earth.

answers.text: To stand before the two mountains
To wait until the temple was built
To go around and through the earth
To return to the north country

questions.text: Into whose house was the speaker told to go, where they had come from Babylon?
questions.explanation: He was to take of the captivity, of Heldai, of Tobijah and of Jedaiah, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah.

answers.text: The house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah
The house of Berechiah the son of Iddo
The house of Joshua the son of Jehozadak
The house of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel

questions.text: What was he to make of the silver and gold, and on whose head was it to be set?
questions.explanation: He was to take silver and gold, make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.

answers.text: A lamp stand, in the temple
A signet, on the hand of Zerubbabel
A turban, on the head of Jedaiah
Crowns, on the head of Joshua

questions.text: What is said about the man whose name is the Branch?
questions.explanation: He shall grow up out of his place and shall build Yahweh's temple; he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule on his throne.

answers.text: He shall gather the nations for battle
He shall build Yahweh's temple and rule on his throne
He shall measure the city with a line
He shall carry the crowns to Babylon

questions.text: On what condition does the text say this will happen?
questions.explanation: The closing words say this will happen if you will diligently obey Yahweh your God's voice.

answers.text: If the crowns are kept in Babylon
If the people fast in the fifth month
If you diligently obey Yahweh your God's voice
If the walls are finished first
